records.description: phae is your lifelong AI guide to work and life — helping you find a path that fits who you are and will last in the age of AI. Start free.

records.name: MasrOdds
records.tagline: أفضل موقع مراجعة كازينوهات للاعبين العرب
records.description: أفضل موقع مراجعة كازينوهات للاعبين العرب

records.name: Lowfly — Cheap flights to your inbox
records.tagline: Get cheap flight deals and fare errors by email. Free.
records.description: Lowfly scans flights 24/7 and sends you alerts when prices drop or fare errors appear. Set your route, choose your plan, and never miss a deal. Free plan includes 1 monthly alert. Premium plans unlock unlimited alerts and priority notifications.

records.name: Hymnote
records.tagline: Write & publish what God is doing in your life
records.description: Hymnote is a free Christian blogging platform where believers publish devotionals, testimonies, poems and Bible reflections. You get your own blog at yourname.hymnote.com, a distraction-free editor with inline Bible verse support, email subscriber notifications, and full SEO, with no ads, no algorithm. Ever.

records.name: BayRight
records.tagline: Unified wallet for utility bills.
records.description: Pay airtime, data, electricity, TV, education, and utility bills from one wallet. Fast checkout and clear receipts with BayRight.

records.name: typotypo: Text to Art
records.tagline: Typography photo art — by your hands, not the algorithm
records.description: typotypo is a typography editor for iPhone. 18 paired-font presets, Metal-powered bend & distort, glow & outline borders, 21 frames, 48 procedural backgrounds, and 6 canvas sizes. AI generates everywhere else — typotypo gives humans the typography controls back.

records.name: Sinalytica
records.tagline: Travel back to 1998 and use Lovable on Windows 98
records.description: Sina Rajaeeian — Software Engineer and ML engineer. Building across AI/ML, web & mobile, and quantitative finance.

records.name: deckshare
records.tagline: Secure file sharing with deep visitor analytics
records.description: deckshare.ai redefines file sharing by combining enterprise-grade data security with deep, real-time visitor tracking. Secure Rooms: Securely share decks, documents, videos, and large files with custom access frameworks. Advanced Security: Native watermarking, visitor verification controls, and granular permissions. Deep Intelligence: AI-driven engagement summaries and slide-by-slide viewing analytics.

records.name: RabbitTravel
records.tagline: Smart travel planning made effortless
records.description: RabbitTravel is an AI-powered travel planning platform that builds optimized itineraries for any destination worldwide. It combines intelligent routing, real-time transit integration, and personalized recommendations to help users plan trips faster and smarter. Unlike traditional travel tools, RabbitTravel dynamically adjusts schedules based on distance, time, and travel preferences, making complex trip planning effortless and highly efficient.

records.name: Heaven Is My Home  Here On Assignment
records.tagline: Design Art Ecommerce
records.description: A bold Christian design reminding believers of their true home and purpose.

records.name: KidWatch
records.tagline: Understand your child’s YouTube without spying or blocking
records.description: KidWatch helps parents understand what their child watches on YouTube without spying or blocking. It turns recent YouTube watch history into an AI safety report with harmful language, timestamps, top channels, watch patterns, parent action items and more. Built for parents who want visibility, context, and better conversations not surveillance.

records.name: PrismMark | 棱镜排版
records.tagline: Beautiful, copy-ready Markdown formatting
records.description: PrismMark turns Markdown into beautiful, copy-ready rich text for documents, blogs, newsletters, and publishing platforms. Choose a template, preview the final layout, then copy or export your content without rebuilding the formatting by hand.

records.name: Datacenter Tycoon
records.tagline: Build the internet - the OpenTTD way
records.description: A free, browser-native Transport Tycoon mod where data is cargo and bandwidth is gold. Mine rare earths, fab the chips, lay the fiber, bill the towns. No download, runs in 5 seconds.

records.name: TypePiano
records.tagline: Learn to read piano sheet music as naturally as typing
records.description: TypePiano is a piano sight-reading trainer designed for beginners and hobbyists who want to read music faster and play more confidently. TypePiano treats sight-reading like typing practice: Train eyes-to-hands reaction before playing full songs Instant feedback on accuracy and streaks Supports computer keyboard & MIDI keyboards Customizable difficulty and note sets With 5–10 minutes a day, beginners can quickly build the reflexes needed to read sheet music effortlessly.

records.name: PyMapStitcher 2 - Maps Downloader
records.tagline: Download Maps, Maps, Download, tile stitiching
records.description: A low ram maps dowloader and stiticher.

records.name: Cuffoo
records.tagline: Shop Baby Onesies & Bodysuits | Cuffoo Collection
records.description: Find the best baby bodysuits at Cuffoo. From newborn onesies to long sleeve bodysuits — gentle, breathable cotton pieces designed for sensitive infant skin and daily wear.

records.name: Huddle Social AI | Events, Games, Perks
records.tagline: Where Campus Comes to Life
records.description: Currently @ 7 colleges; used by 2500+ students; Uncover the pulse of your college community with an enhanced platform that brings everything fun in one place; Dive into a wide array of events, from social gatherings to enriching academic talks; Search and subscribe to any campus club; Play daily trivia and compete with peers; Get discounts at food places around campus as a penguin; Discover student-listed apartments & sublets

records.name: Entrepreneur Community Update
records.tagline: Entrepreneur Community Creation
records.description: FindPartner is the #1 All-In-One Business Partner Finder App and has 1,093+ Users which are Developers, Designers, Copywriters, Customer Support Reps, Founders, Project Managers and more! Find a StartUp partner online to build your new big idea together.

records.name: Commentsell
records.tagline: Help grocery stores sell through Facebook comments
records.description: Turn your social media into a powerful sales channel through commentselling — let customers comment to buy directly from your posts.

records.name: Menulizer
records.tagline: Digital menus for restaurants
records.description: Transform your restaurant with modern digital menus. Mobile-first design with QR code support for contactless ordering. Create beautiful menus in minutes. Free plan available with no coding required.

records.name: TractCast
records.tagline: Property intelligence for real estate teams
records.description: TractCast brings property search, parcel data, ownership records, zoning, building permits, council activity, environmental layers, CMBS loan signals, 3D site planning, and client-ready reports into one real estate map. Instead of jumping between county sites, GIS portals, permit databases, spreadsheets, and PDFs, residential and commercial real estate teams can research a property, understand nearby activity, and export a clean report from the same workflow.

records.name: SpotterFuel
records.tagline: Same-muscle swaps when equipment is taken
records.description: SpotterFuel is an iPhone app for crowded gyms. Pick the muscle and exercise you planned, mark blocked equipment, and get practical same-muscle alternatives with sets, reps, equipment, and coaching cues. No account required.

records.name: MyDojang - Martial Arts Management
records.tagline: Studio Management Built for Discipline
records.description: The complete management platform for martial arts studios. Manage students, track belt progress, handle scheduling, process billing, and run kiosk check-ins — all from one app. Starting at $49/mo.

records.name: Carpets Online
records.tagline: Sprite Twist Pile Carpet Grey for Busy Family Homes
records.description: The Sprite Twist Pile Carpet in Grey brings a clean, modern look that fits easily into bedrooms, hallways, stairs, and living spaces. Its twist pile design helps maintain a fresh appearance while adding softness and comfort underfoot.

records.name: Radio Player
records.tagline: A beautiful, minimal, and fast global radio player.
records.description: I love internet radio, but I was tired of bloated apps filled with heavy ads and chaotic layouts. So, I built a solution for purists. Our app is crafted for one thing: listening. Featuring a beautiful, modern, and clean interface built for seamless navigation, it gives you fast, lightweight access to over 70,000 global radio stations without any unnecessary clutter. No confusing menus, no setup fatigue—just pure, instant audio.

records.name: Picmori
records.tagline: Clean your gallery with fast swipe sorting
records.description: Your gallery fills up with screenshots, duplicates, blurry photos, and random pictures you never need. Picmori lets you clean it by swiping: keep what matters, remove the rest. You can use the launch code "CLEANUP" inside the app to get 1 year free. No credit card needed, no surprise charges later.

records.name: GrapeRoot
records.tagline: Cut your AI Bill by 60–70% with a local codebase graph!
records.description: AI coding tools re-read your entire codebase every turn. GrapeRoot fixes this. It builds an AST + dependency graph of your project locally, then injects only the relevant files (~4,000 tokens) before the AI starts thinking. No cloud, no tool-call overhead, no code leaves your machine. 60–70% token savings, measurable on real codebases. Works with Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Gemini CLI, and GitHub Copilot. Open source, zero config, 150ms injection.

records.name: Imagined Ware
records.tagline: Software products for everyday problems
records.description: Imagined Ware builds practical software for real-world problems. Our products include Da bebi, a verified rental and property management platform, and 6cript, an AI workspace that helps non-technical people turn plain-language requests into useful software, workflows, pages, and tools.

records.name: ViNano AI-image&video creation platform
records.tagline: Generate stunning high-quality images & videos in seconds
records.description: ViNano AI — free AI image editing & video platform. Integrates VideoAI 3.1 and Seedance for image-to-video & text-to-video. ViNano Pro powered. Professional editing. all-in-one AI image & video creation platform
